tickets.title: Collect tax document packet
tickets.text:
Use this workflow to gather the client's annual tax materials, identify missing items, and package the documents for planning review and tax coordination. Confirm whether the client expects documents from employers, custodians, banks, charitable organizations, mortgage servicers, business entities, or equity compensation platforms.

subTasks.title: Request core tax documents
subTasks.text: Send the client a document request covering W-2s, 1099s, K-1s, charitable receipts, mortgage interest statements, estimated tax vouchers, business income summaries, and any notices from IRS or state tax agencies.

subTasks.title: Track received and missing items
subTasks.text: Update the document tracker with received items, expected sources, and open gaps. Note whether any documents appear preliminary, corrected, or incomplete.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor summary
subTasks.text: Summarize planning observations, including large income changes, capital gains, charitable activity, retirement contributions, and any items requiring tax specialist review.

subTasks.title: Coordinate tax planning review
subTasks.text: Route the organized packet and summary to the tax planning specialist for review before sharing follow-up questions with the client or CPA.
